description: This file defines React components and related functions for embedding calendar widgets in different formats (HTML, React, Atom, Preview). It includes tab configurations, component rendering logic, and utility functions for generating embed code snippets.

methods.name: getEmbedTypeSpecificString
methods.description: Generates embed code string based on framework, embed type, and other parameters.

methods.name: getEmbedUIInstructionString
methods.description: Creates a UI instruction string with theme and layout options.

methods.name: getInstructionString
methods.description: Formats a string for API instructions with given arguments.

methods.name: useGetEmbedSnippetString
methods.description: Returns a string containing a self-invoking function to initialize the calendar embed, customized with namespace and URL.
